verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 publishes its own coding-agents use-case recipe: a template with browser tooling, plus snapshotting an initialized workspace and claiming parallel sandboxes from it. It also documents first-party backend integrations for OpenAI Agents SDK and LangChain Deep Agents Code, and supervised long-running agent runtimes. However, none of the evidence names Claude Code or Codex specifically, so following a recipe for those exact agents is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor recipe for installing and running Claude Code or Codex in a sandbox, documented agent credential/auth setup for those CLIs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
